Triton scans 4096 single-matrix inputs for exact upper-triangular structure and returns compact identity-Q factors with zero tau; falls back to torch.geqrf otherwise. Validation passes, but benchmark set has no upper case so score stays baseline/noise.

Best committed score 115781.618199 versus parent 115764.261, effectively no improvement/slightly slower. Further work should target benchmark-present rankdef/nearrank/clustered/dense cases rather than structural shortcuts absent from the active set.
